qa_pairs.question: What is the procedure number and title for replacing the front engine carrier?
qa_pairs.answer: The procedure is 41 11 011/001 - REPLACING RIGHT/LEFT FRONT ENGINE CARRIER (PARTIAL REPLACEMENT) WITH WHEEL HOUSE - All Wheel Drive.

qa_pairs.question: What dimension should be marked when cutting according to the sketch?
qa_pairs.answer: Mark cut according to sketch with dimension A = 30 mm (1.181").

qa_pairs.question: What critical warning is given when cutting through the engine carrier?
qa_pairs.answer: Important! Be careful not to damage metal sheet on inside when cutting through engine carrier on side and bottom.

qa_pairs.question: What should be done after lifting off the engine carrier from the section?
qa_pairs.answer: After lifting off the engine carrier from the section, straighten and grind mating surfaces.

qa_pairs.question: Which components need to be removed or disconnected according to the parts list?
qa_pairs.answer: Remove or disconnect: ground lead on battery, bumper, wheel house trim, radiator grill sections, engine hood lock/release, front spoiler, headlights, front fog lamps, bumper brackets, heater well, entrance cover strips, front seat, instrument panel trim, carpet on A pillar, passenger compartment carpets, footwell insulation sheet, brake booster, master cylinder, fuel filter, ignition coil, brake lines, engine, front axle with transmission, engine compartment wires, and radiator trim.

qa_pairs.question: What reference is made regarding the front panel wall removal?
What reference is made regarding wheel house removal?
What important note is given about the ABS acceleration pick-up?
qa_pairs.answer: If the console holding the ABS acceleration pick-up is straightened or welded on the left wheel house, the acceleration pick-up must be adjusted afterwards. See Group 34 (ABS - All Wheel Drive) for adjusting procedures.

qa_pairs.question: What should be done with the determined cut after marking?
What operations are mentioned for the spot welds?
What should be checked and adjusted during this procedure?
qa_pairs.answer: Check and adjust front wheel alignment.
